Field.Label: Puts the appliance back to idle and forgets the cycle in progress, without recording it or sending anything. Use it to clear a cycle stuck "running" because the meter is stuck above the run threshold — the cycleOverrun event warns you when that happens. Nothing is recorded, because a cycle that never really ended has no honest duration or energy.

Sends a test message through whichever channels this appliance has switched on, so you can prove Pushover and email work without waiting for a real cycle. It uses the appliance's own recipients and settings, and reports in the log what was delivered. The appliance's state is not touched.
